title: Water Observations from Space contribute to a greater understanding of flooding in Australia
lineage: Publisher or operator text. Local file preserves selected passages and research notes.

passages.note: The developer dates first release of WOfS to 2014, describing the continental map and its access through the Australian Flood Risk Information Portal.

passages.locator: Historical challenge – floods in Australia; Mapping surface water using satellite data
passages.note: Existing flood studies largely concerned populated areas. The National Flood Risk Information Project commissioned in 2011 called for a nationally consistent historical water product. Geoscience Australia developed the automated water classifier and summarised the fraction of clear observations in which water was detected.

file.method: Selected, claim-specific paraphrases and short excerpts from the cited passages.
